atoms.one_line: a[i] == *(a+i); p+i steps i elements; p-q counts elements.

atoms.name: Strings

atoms.name: Scope and storage
atoms.one_line: auto resets per call; static and global persist; inner blocks shadow.

atoms.name: Parameter passing
atoms.one_line: Everything is by value; pass &x or ** to modify the caller.

atoms.name: Evaluation order and UB
atoms.one_line: Unsequenced writes to one object are undefined; && || , sequence.

atoms.one_line: malloc/free, leaks vs dangling, struct pointer arithmetic, list pointer walks.
